user.title: House Assistant
user.description: Heating with AI, covers and meter reading on one model of the house. Choose the modules you want to use; rooms, windows and meters are added in the House Assistant panel in the sidebar afterwards.

data_description.modules: The parts of the house House Assistant takes care of. Can be changed later under Settings > Modules.

house.title: House
house.description: These settings apply to every module. Heating and covers need an outdoor temperature: a sensor or a weather entity.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: For heating and covers (e.g. a helper combining several sensors). Without it the current temperature of the weather entity is used.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional. For the ventilation advice of the heating; without it the humidity of the weather entity is used.
data_description.weather: Recommended. Its forecast is used by the heating day decision, the expected sun of the heating and the summer day of the covers. Without an outdoor sensor its current temperature applies.
data_description.language: Logbook, last reason, push messages and notifications of every module. Automatic = the language of Home Assistant.
data_description.notify_services: Get the messages of the house, e.g. when an open window prevents sun protection (notify services only, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone).
data_description.workday_entity: Optional, e.g. the Workday integration (knows public holidays). Without a sensor the weekend days decide.
data_description.weekend_days: Only without a workday sensor: on these days e.g. the weekend time of the morning opening applies.
data_description.house_azimuth: Direction the front looks to (90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west), e.g. read from a map. For the house in the sun compass of the covers.
data_description.house_width: Also the back. With the depth the house appears in the sun compass, and the draft through rooms between two open windows is recognised.
data_description.house_depth: Length of the two side walls.
data_description.draft_reach: How far a room may be from the line between two open windows of other rooms to still get their draft (default 2 m).

heating.title: Heating
heating.description: Sensors of the heating, heating period and frost protection. Rooms are added afterwards.

data_description.pv_power: Optional. PV power (W or kW) as an indicator for sunshine. The solar gain per room is learned from it.
data_description.pv_forecast: Optional, only together with the PV power sensor. Expected PV energy of the next hour (Wh or kWh, e.g. Forecast.Solar) or expected power in one hour (W or kW). Without it the sun is estimated from the hourly weather forecast and the sun position.
data_description.heat_meter: Optional. Meter reading of the heat meter of the circuits controlled here (Wh, kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ, e.g. total_increasing). The AI then sees the measured heat; it is also shown in the panel. Seldom and coarse readings are fine.
data_description.season_start: Outside the heating period all circuits stay off (frost protection only) and the AI is not asked.
data_description.season_end: Last day of the heating period, may be in the next year (e.g. 31.03.).
data_description.frost_temperature: Always applies, also outside the heating period and with a switched-off thermostat.
data_description.forecast_trust: Share of the expected PV power the control relies on when it holds back heating (100 % = full forecast, 0 % = only the current PV power counts).
data_description.season_start_day: Heating is possible from this date (e.g. 1 October).
data_description.season_end_day: Last day of the heating period (e.g. 31 March); the period may span the turn of the year.

heating_vacation.title: Vacation
heating_vacation.description: Vacation temperature and preheating for the return. The vacation itself, its external sources and the return are set in the house.

data_description.vacation_temperature: Target for all rooms during vacation.
data_description.preheat_reserve: Additional time added to the calculated preheating time.

heating_decision.title: Heating day decision
heating_decision.description: Start value of the heating day rule. It is only set here during setup; afterwards theta is learned and the learned value can be edited under 'Heating day decision'.

data_description.theta_start: Heating is needed when the forecast maximum of the day is below this value (e.g. 16 °C). Learned afterwards.

heating_ai.title: AI (Claude)
heating_ai.description: The AI checks the parameters periodically. Without an API key only the local control runs; the nightly run decides with the local rule then.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Without a key the local control runs alone. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.
data_description.nightly_time: Daily decision whether heating is needed today (also the start of the evaluated day). Runs with and without the AI.

heating_ai_model.title: AI model and budget
heating_ai_model.description: The key was accepted. Choose the model and how much the AI may cost per month.

data_description.model: Model for all AI calls. Prices below are suggestions for the selected model and can be changed.
data_description.monthly_budget: In US dollars, as Anthropic bills. No AI calls once the costs of the month reach this value (until the month changes).

data_description.ai_task_entity: AI task entity that reads the pictures (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or Ollama with image support). A meter can use its own one.
data_description.notify_rejected: Main switch for the notifications in Home Assistant. When they come for which meter is set at the meter under "Notifications".

shutter_summer.title: Summer day
shutter_summer.description: Sun protection only runs on summer days.

data.night_threshold: Late summer day only with a night from

data_description.summer_threshold: Without a summer day there is no sun protection. During the day the summer day also starts when the outdoor temperature rises above this value (see night).
data_description.night_threshold: A summer day only by the outdoor temperature counts only when the forecast low of the coming night is at least this value. When the night cools down (spring, autumn), the warmth stays in the house. Without a low in the forecast the summer day counts as before.
data_description.heating_entity: Optional, e.g. an input_boolean "heating season" or the heating day of a heating control. While it is on, the warmth of the sun is welcome: sun protection only when the room of a window is too warm anyway. Windows without a room temperature are then not lowered.
data_description.use_heating_day: Without an own heat need entity: the heating day of the heating module, but only within the heating period. Only while the heating module is switched on.
data_description.day_change_time: Forecast check and reset of the daily sun protection markers and notifications.
data_description.forecast_type: Automatic takes the first kind the weather entity supports (daily, twice daily, hourly). From hourly values the high of the day and the low of the night are calculated.

shutter_evening.title: Evening mode
shutter_evening.description: The evening mode closes the covers once and blocks auto up. Windows can use own times.

data_description.evening_earliest: The evening mode never starts before this time.
data_description.evening_elevation: The evening mode starts when the sun drops below this elevation (e.g. -4 °).
data_description.evening_latest: Time fallback: the evening mode starts at this time at the latest.
data_description.night_end: Evening mode and evening markers end at this time (or at sunrise if that is earlier).
data_description.follow_up_earliest: A window closed in the evening closes the cover only after this time.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter a new key. Empty removes the key and disables the AI.

data_description.api_key: Optional. Without a key the local control runs alone. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.

reauth_confirm.title: API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description:
Anthropic rejected the stored API key, so the AI checks and the AI part of the heating day decision are paused. The local control keeps running with the learned values.

Enter a valid key from console.anthropic.com (API keys), without spaces. Leave the field empty to go on without the AI.

data_description.api_key: Checked with Anthropic before it is saved. The key is only stored in Home Assistant and never logged.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Assistant is already set up. Rooms, windows and meters are added in the panel.

error.latest_before_earliest: The latest time is before the earliest one. Move the latest time later or the earliest earlier.
error.night_end_after_evening: The end of the night must be before the earliest evening start, e.g. 03:30 with an evening from 17:00.
error.min_above_max: The minimum is above the maximum. Swap or adjust the values.
error.azimuth_equal: Azimuth from and to must differ.
error.no_lux_sensor: The group of this window has no brightness sensor. Add a brightness sensor to the group or choose another mode.
error.need_temperature_source: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity; without a temperature there is no summer day.
error.not_numeric: This entity does not report a number. Choose a sensor with a measured value (e.g. °C, lx, W, W/m²).
error.invalid_notify_service: Only notification services (notify.…) are allowed. Choose a service from the list.
error.cover_in_use: This cover is already controlled by another window. Choose another cover or change the other window.
error.invalid_day_month: Please enter a valid date (DD.MM., e.g. 01.10.); a day like 31.02. does not exist.
error.invalid_auth: Anthropic rejected the API key. Check it at console.anthropic.com under API keys and paste it without spaces. Without a key the local control keeps running.
error.cannot_connect: Anthropic cannot be reached. Check the internet connection, proxy and firewall. The key was not saved.
error.max_below_base: The maximum interval must be at least the check interval (e.g. check every 4 h, at most every 48 h).
error.outdoor_required: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity.

data_description.show_panel: Off: the dashboard disappears from the sidebar but stays reachable with "Configure" at the integration.

vacation.title: Vacation
vacation.description: The vacation of the house applies to every module: the switch “Vacation” with departure and return on the device House Assistant. External sources still count as well.

data_description.vacation_entities: While one of them is on it is vacation as well (e.g. an input_boolean or a calendar). Applies to every module.
data_description.return_entity: Optional: input_datetime, datetime or timestamp entity. The heating starts early enough (learned heat-up time plus reserve) to reach the normal target on return; an own return of the switch comes first.
data_description.vacation_window_alert: When the vacation starts a message with every open, tilted or unknown window; on vacation a message right away when a window is opened or tilted. To the notification services of the house, without any as a notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.vacation_ventilation_pause: On vacation the ventilation advice shows “Vacation”, “ventilation recommended” is off. Vacation minutes do not count for the AI ventilation check and stay out of the humidity profile.
data_description.vacation_heat_protection: On vacation the sun protection lowers without waiting for room temperature, air conditioner or heat need. Summer day, outdoor temperature, sun sensors, hold times and the sun switch of the window still apply.

data_description.ai_task_entity: AI task entity that reads the pictures (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or Ollama with image support). A meter can use its own one.
data_description.notify_rejected: Main switch for the notifications in Home Assistant. When they come for which meter is set at the meter under "Notifications".

data_description.outdoor_temperature: For the summer day and the temperature condition of every window. Without a sensor the current temperature of the weather entity is used (at least one of both). Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.weather: Its daily forecast decides at the day change whether today is a summer day. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.language: Logbook, last reason and push messages. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.notify_services: Get a message when an open window prevents sun protection (notify services only, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone). Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.workday_entity: Optional, for the morning opening by time (e.g. Workday integration, knows public holidays). Without a sensor the weekend days decide. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.weekend_days: Only without a workday sensor: on these days the weekend time of the morning opening applies. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.

shutter_override.title: Manual override
shutter_override.description: When a movement by hand (switch, app, voice assistant) starts the override of a window. Duration and further settings are set per window.

data_description.override_trigger: Only with a real movement: a command to a cover already at its target (e.g. "open all" while it is open) does not start an override. Every command: also without movement, as before.

data_description.evening_latest: Time fallback: the evening mode starts at this time at the latest.

shutter_vacation.title: Vacation simulation
shutter_vacation.description: Random opening in the morning and closing in the evening while the vacation of the house is active.

data_description.vacation_morning_start: Closed covers of the windows in the simulation open at a random time after this.
data_description.vacation_morning_window: Each window opens at a random time within this period.
data_description.vacation_evening_start: Starts the evening for the windows in the simulation and closes them at random times. The normal evening run rests during vacation.
data_description.vacation_evening_window: Each window closes at a random time within this period.

shutter_protection.title: Weather protection
shutter_protection.description: Wind and rain move the covers of the windows that take part to their protection position, also during an override and with the automatic off. Frost keeps a gap when closing. Positions are set per window.

data_description.wind_entity: Wind speed or gusts, e.g. from a weather station.
data_description.wind_threshold: In the unit of the wind sensor (e.g. km/h or m/s).
data_description.rain_entity: A rain sensor that turns on, or an amount of rain (e.g. mm/h).
data_description.rain_threshold: Only for a numeric rain sensor: rain counts above this value.
data_description.frost_threshold: Outdoor temperature. Only windows with a frost position take part.
data_description.protection_release: A protection ends only after the value stayed on the safe side this long. An unavailable sensor never ends a protection.

data.catch_up_after: Catch up the evening run from

data_description.startup_delay: No movement for this time after Home Assistant started (sensors and covers are still coming online).
data_description.catch_up_after: After the restart protection the evening run is caught up for windows not yet closed this evening, but only after this time.

data_description.window_closed_delay: A window contact must report closed this long before closing after the window, sun protection or the close trigger act (against bouncing contacts).
data_description.command_interval: Several covers move one after the other with this spacing (against radio collisions). 0 = all at once.
data_description.verify_after: If a cover has not reached its target by then, the command is repeated once; then a notification is sent. 0 = off.

heating_general.title: General
heating_general.description: Sensors, heating period and frost protection.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: Sensor for the outdoor temperature (e.g. a helper combining several sensors). Without it the current temperature of the weather entity is used. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Optional. Needed for the ventilation recommendation; without it the humidity of the weather entity is used. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.weather: Optional but recommended. Its forecast is used for the nightly heating day decision and the expected sun. Without an outdoor sensor its current temperature is the outdoor temperature. Only while nothing is set under Settings > House.
data_description.pv_power: Optional. PV power (W or kW) as an indicator for sunshine. The solar gain per room is learned from it.
data_description.pv_forecast: Optional, only together with the PV power sensor. Expected PV energy of the next hour (Wh or kWh, e.g. Forecast.Solar) or expected power in one hour (W or kW). Without it the sun is estimated from the hourly weather forecast and the sun position.
data_description.heat_meter: Optional. Meter reading of the heat meter of the circuits controlled here (Wh, kWh, MWh, MJ or GJ, e.g. total_increasing). The AI then sees the measured heat; it is also shown in the panel. Seldom and coarse readings are fine.
data_description.season_start: Outside the heating period all circuits stay off (frost protection only) and the AI is not asked.
data_description.season_end: Last day of the heating period, may be in the next year (e.g. 31.03.).
data_description.frost_temperature: Always applies, also outside the heating period and with a switched-off thermostat.
data_description.forecast_trust: Share of the expected PV power the control relies on when it holds back heating (100 % = full forecast, 0 % = only the current PV power counts).
data_description.season_start_day: Heating is possible from this date (e.g. 1 October).
data_description.season_end_day: Last day of the heating period (e.g. 31 March); the period may span the turn of the year.

heating_vacation.title: Vacation
heating_vacation.description: Vacation temperature and preheating for the return. The vacation itself, its external sources and the return are set in the house.

data_description.vacation_temperature: Target for all rooms during vacation (e.g. 17 °C).
data_description.preheat_reserve: Additional time added to the calculated preheating time (e.g. 30 min).

heating_rules.title: Emergency rule
heating_rules.description: Comfort safety net on days without heating.

data_description.emergency_enabled: On days without heating, a room may still heat if the temperature expected after the lead time is long and clearly below its target, without airing.
data_description.emergency_delta: How far below the target the temperature expected after the lead time has to be (at least the switch-on hysteresis).
data_description.emergency_duration: How long the expected temperature has to stay that low (e.g. 45 min).
data_description.emergency_window_quiet: Airing does not count: windows must not have changed for this time.
data_description.force_on_below: Below target by this much the circuit heats regardless of every prediction and the expected sun.

heating_ventilation.title: Ventilation
heating_ventilation.description: Thresholds of the ventilation recommendation. They are start values: the AI ventilation check adjusts them per room from the learned humidity profile of each room (humidity threshold set per room).

data.ventilation_cooling_margin: Minimum distance above target for cooling

data_description.ventilation_min_ah_advantage: Absolute humidity is the water content of the air in g/m³, independent of temperature. Outside air must contain at least this much less water for 'ventilate now' (e.g. 0.8 g/m³).
data_description.ventilation_max_reference_excess: Drying is not recommended if outside is warmer than inside by more than this.
data_description.ventilation_min_cooling_advantage: 'Ventilation useful' if inside is warmer than outside by at least this (not while heating).
data_description.ventilation_cooling_margin: Within the heating period 'ventilation useful' (cooling) is only recommended if the room is at least this much warmer than its target. Not used outside the heating period. Rooms without a heating circuit use their initial target.
data_description.ventilation_cooling_min_temp: 'Ventilation useful' (cooling) only from this room temperature on, all year. 0 = off. In addition cooling is never recommended if the outside air would raise the relative humidity of the room above its humidity threshold.
data_description.night_start_hour: Used when the reference is another room: cooling advantage only counts at night.
data_description.ventilation_ai_enabled: All year the AI reviews the ventilation thresholds of every room with a humidity sensor: it learns what is usual in each room, how low the humidity can get and what airing really achieves. Shares the monthly AI budget.
data_description.ventilation_check_interval: First interval; it doubles with every check that changed nothing relevant and starts over when a room stays humid or a value changes.
data_description.ventilation_check_max_interval: The interval never grows beyond this.
data_description.ventilation_energy_rh_per_k: Energy saving: within the heating period airing costs heat, the more the colder it is outside. The humidity must then exceed the threshold by this much per Kelvin outside is colder than the room (e.g. 0.25 %/K: at 21 °C inside and 1 °C outside 5 % more), at most up to 70 %, above which airing is always recommended against mould. 0 = off. Start value, the AI adjusts it per room.
data_description.ventilation_mould_rh: From this relative humidity airing is always recommended, even in frost and right after an airing; the energy saving surcharge never goes beyond it. Lower it for rooms with cold exterior walls. Start value, the AI adjusts it per room.
data_description.ventilation_airing_target_below: The suggested airing time aims at this far below the humidity threshold. Start value for the AI.
data_description.ventilation_airing_time_factor: Scales the suggested airing time. Once two airings are evaluated it is computed from the learned air exchange of the room and the temperature difference, before that from the outside temperature (5 min in frost up to 20 min when warm). Start value for the AI.
data_description.ventilation_airing_pause: After an airing moisture comes back from walls and furniture. Drying is recommended again only after this pause (below the mould limit), which saves heat and nagging. Start value for the AI.

heating_ai.title: AI
heating_ai.description: Model, times, budget and prices. The API key is changed via 'Reconfigure'.

data_description.model: Model for all AI calls. Prices below are suggestions for the selected model and can be changed.
data_description.effort: Claude thinks before it answers. More effort can give better answers but uses more tokens, which are billed as output. 'auto' leaves it to the model.
data_description.nightly_time: Daily decision whether heating is needed today (also the start of the evaluated day).
data_description.check_interval: Base interval of the periodic AI check on heating days (e.g. 4 h). It doubles after every check without relevant change.
data_description.check_max_interval: Upper limit for the doubled interval (e.g. 48 h).
data_description.monthly_budget: In US dollars, as Anthropic bills. No AI calls once the costs of the month reach this value (until the month changes). A check usually costs a few cents, so 5 USD allow about 100 to 200 calls.
data_description.price_input: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.price_output: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills (thinking counts as output).
data_description.price_cache_write: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.price_cache_read: US dollars per million tokens, as Anthropic bills.
data_description.max_output_tokens: Upper limit per answer, thinking included (too low cuts answers off, they are paid but discarded). Also the upper bound of the cost estimate before a call.

heating_decision.title: Heating day decision (experts)
heating_decision.description: Learned threshold, evaluation, learning steps and phase changes of the heating day decision.

data.too_cold_minutes: Too cold minutes for heating need

data_description.theta: Current threshold of the heating day rule: if the forecast maximum is below it, heating is needed. A change replaces the learned value; learning continues from there.
data_description.too_cold_margin: Evaluation: a room counts as too cold below target minus this (airing excluded).
data_description.too_cold_minutes: Evaluation: this many minutes too cold mean heating was needed.

learning_steps.name: Learning steps
learning_steps.description: How much theta and the margin change after an evaluated error.

data_description.theta_step_up: After error A, i.e. it got too cold on a day without heating (e.g. 1.0 K).
data_description.theta_step_down: After error B, i.e. heating ran although it was not needed (e.g. 1.0 K).
data_description.puffer_step_up: After error A for the cold room.

phases.name: Decision phases
phases.description: When the heating day decision moves between AI leads, shared and rule leads.

data.phase_fallback_errors_7d: Rule errors in 7 days for fallback

data_description.phase_shared_min_days: Who decides the heating day: first the AI leads, then AI and rule decide together, finally the rule leads. 'AI leads' -> 'shared' after this many evaluated days (e.g. 14).
data_description.phase_shared_min_agreement: Minimum agreement of rule and AI.
data_description.phase_rule_min_days: Phase 'shared' -> 'rule leads' after this many days in phase 'shared'.
data_description.phase_rule_min_agreement: Minimum agreement of rule and AI.
data_description.phase_max_rule_errors: Maximum rule errors within the period for a phase change.
data_description.phase_fallback_errors_7d: This many rule errors within 7 days move back one phase.
data_description.phase_ai_check_every_days: When the rule leads and is sure, the AI is still asked every this many days.

heating_ai_limits.title: AI limits
heating_ai_limits.description: Minimum, maximum and largest change per check for every parameter the AI may adjust (heating and ventilation).

user.title: Room
user.description: A room of the house. With a temperature sensor it gets heating and ventilation advice, with a heating circuit also a thermostat. Windows are added as windows and assigned to the room there.

data_description.name: Name of the room, also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.area: Optional. The device of the room is placed in this area; its floor counts for cross ventilation.
data_description.floor_area: Floor area of the room, for the split of the heat meter over the rooms. Without it the room takes no part in the split.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature. Without a sensor the room has no heating and no ventilation advice (e.g. a room only for covers).
data_description.humidity_sensor: Relative humidity, needed for the ventilation recommendation.

data_description.heater_switch: Switch of the actuator (e.g. a relay). Leave empty for a room with ventilation recommendation only.
data_description.default_target: Target until you change it on the thermostat card.
data_description.min_target: Lowest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.max_target: Highest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.min_on_time: Always respected (protects the actuator). Not learned.
data_description.heating_type: How the circuit heats. A floor stores heat for hours, radiators react within minutes; the AI judges the learned values with this in mind.

start_values.name: Start values (learned later)
start_values.description: Only when the room is created. Afterwards the learned values are edited.

data.dead_time: Dead time until the room warms (start value)

data_description.window_delay: Window open this long pauses heating. The AI may adjust it.
data_description.recovery_time: After closing, heating waits this long because floor and walls often reheat the room. Learned afterwards.
data_description.dead_time: Time from switching on until the room gets warmer; underfloor heating often 30-90 min, radiators 5-20 min. Learned afterwards.
data_description.puffer: Heating day rule: how far above the target a room must be at the nightly run to manage a day without heating (e.g. 0.7 K). Learned afterwards.

data_description.ventilation_rh_threshold: Start value of the relative humidity from which ventilating is recommended (e.g. 65 % for bathrooms); the AI ventilation check adjusts it to the room.
data_description.reference_temperature: Optional, for rooms aired via another room.
data_description.reference_humidity: Required together with the reference temperature.
data_description.ventilation_block_entity: Optional. While it blocks, no ventilation is recommended: a cover while closed (e.g. sun protection down), a climate entity or water heater while not off (e.g. air conditioner running), a switch, binary sensor, fan or similar while on.

draft.name: Draft from other rooms
draft.description: Windows of other rooms whose opening together also cools this room (cross ventilation). Per combination choose the windows that must be open together. As soon as every window of one combination is open, the room behaves as with its own window open: heating pauses after the window delay and waits the recovery time. A combination with a single window triggers on its own.

data_description.draft_group_1: e.g. kids' room + bathroom; a second combination e.g. kids' room + bedroom.

sun_protection.name: Sun protection
sun_protection.description: Defaults for the covers of the windows of this room. Room temperature and target come from the temperature sensor and the thermostat of the room unless a window has its own room temperature.

data_description.cooling_entity: Optional: while this air conditioner cools, the room counts as too warm. Sun protection then takes load off the air conditioner. Applies to every window of the room without its own air conditioner.

reconfigure.title: Room
reconfigure.description: A room of the house. With a temperature sensor it gets heating and ventilation advice, with a heating circuit also a thermostat. Windows are added as windows and assigned to the room there.

data_description.name: Name of the room, also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.area: Optional. The device of the room is placed in this area; its floor counts for cross ventilation.
data_description.floor_area: Floor area of the room, for the split of the heat meter over the rooms. Without it the room takes no part in the split.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Room temperature. Without a sensor the room has no heating and no ventilation advice (e.g. a room only for covers).
data_description.humidity_sensor: Relative humidity, needed for the ventilation recommendation.

data_description.heater_switch: Switch of the actuator (e.g. a relay). Leave empty for a room with ventilation recommendation only.
data_description.default_target: Target until you change it on the thermostat card.
data_description.min_target: Lowest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.max_target: Highest value of the thermostat card.
data_description.min_on_time: Always respected (protects the actuator). Not learned.
data_description.heating_type: How the circuit heats. A floor stores heat for hours, radiators react within minutes; the AI judges the learned values with this in mind.

learned_values.name: Learned values
learned_values.description: Values the control currently uses. A change replaces the learned or AI-adjusted value; learning continues from there.

data.dead_time: Dead time until the room warms

data_description.window_delay: Window open this long pauses heating. The AI may adjust it.
data_description.recovery_time: Learned wait after the windows are closed.
data_description.dead_time: Learned time until the room warms up after switching on.
data_description.puffer: Heating day rule: needed margin above the target at the nightly run (learned).

data_description.ventilation_rh_threshold: Start value of the relative humidity from which ventilating is recommended (e.g. 65 % for bathrooms); the AI ventilation check adjusts it to the room.
data_description.reference_temperature: Optional, for rooms aired via another room.
data_description.reference_humidity: Required together with the reference temperature.
data_description.ventilation_block_entity: Optional. While it blocks, no ventilation is recommended: a cover while closed (e.g. sun protection down), a climate entity or water heater while not off (e.g. air conditioner running), a switch, binary sensor, fan or similar while on.

A combination with a single window triggers on its own.

data_description.draft_group_1: e.g. kids' room + bathroom; a second combination e.g. kids' room + bedroom.

sun_protection.name: Sun protection
sun_protection.description: Defaults for the covers of the windows of this room. Room temperature and target come from the temperature sensor and the thermostat of the room unless a window has its own room temperature.

data_description.cooling_entity: Optional: while this air conditioner cools, the room counts as too warm. Sun protection then takes load off the air conditioner. Applies to every window of the room without its own air conditioner.

error.name_in_use: Another room already has this name. Please choose a unique name (export and import find rooms by name).
error.switch_in_use: This switch already controls another room. Each circuit can belong to one room only: choose another switch, or remove it from the other room first.
error.min_above_max: The smallest target must be below the largest target. Please change one of the two values (both in °C).
error.target_out_of_range: The start target must lie between the smallest and the largest target. Please adjust it or the limits.
error.reference_incomplete: Reference temperature and reference humidity only work together: choose both sensors or neither.
error.temperature_required: A heating circuit and the ventilation advice need a temperature sensor of the room.

user.title: Group
user.description: A group is a direction of the sun with its sensors. Thresholds are set per window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.azimuth_from: Sun direction from which the sun shines on the windows (90 ° = east, 180 ° = south, 270 ° = west). The bounds themselves do not count.
data_description.azimuth_to: When the sun reaches this direction, protected covers open again (auto up).
data_description.radiation_sensors: Solar radiation in W/m², e.g. from a weather service or a weather station.
data_description.pv_sensors: Power of a solar system or panel facing this direction (W).
data_description.lux_sensors: Lux sensors at the windows. Every sensor of the group must reach the threshold of the window.

reconfigure.title: Group
reconfigure.description: A group is a direction of the sun with its sensors. Thresholds are set per window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.azimuth_from: Sun direction from which the sun shines on the windows (90 ° = east, 180 ° = south, 270 ° = west). The bounds themselves do not count.
data_description.azimuth_to: When the sun reaches this direction, protected covers open again (auto up).
data_description.radiation_sensors: Solar radiation in W/m², e.g. from a weather service or a weather station.
data_description.pv_sensors: Power of a solar system or panel facing this direction (W).
data_description.lux_sensors: Lux sensors at the windows. Every sensor of the group must reach the threshold of the window.

error.latest_before_earliest: The latest time is before the earliest one. Move the latest time later or the earliest earlier.
error.night_end_after_evening: The end of the night must be before the earliest evening start, e.g. 03:30 with an evening from 17:00.
error.min_above_max: The minimum is above the maximum. Swap or adjust the values.
error.azimuth_equal: Azimuth from and to must differ.
error.no_lux_sensor: The group of this window has no brightness sensor. Add a brightness sensor to the group or choose another mode.
error.need_temperature_source: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity; without a temperature there is no summer day.
error.not_numeric: This entity does not report a number. Choose a sensor with a measured value (e.g. °C, lx, W, W/m²).
error.invalid_notify_service: Only notification services (notify.…) are allowed. Choose a service from the list.
error.cover_in_use: This cover is already controlled by another window. Choose another cover or change the other window.

data_description.name: Also used for the device and its entities.
data_description.room: Optional. The heating of the room uses the contacts of the window; the cover takes room temperature and air conditioner of the room.
data_description.size: How fast airing exchanges the air: the suggested airing time follows it, and the largest opening is suggested for airing. The size applies to every contact of the window.
data_description.cover: Optional. 100 % = open, 0 % = closed. Without a cover the window only serves the heating.
data_description.window_sensors: 'on' = open. Window handles with the states open, tilted and closed work as well. Unknown or unavailable counts as open. A contact belongs to one window only.
data_description.tilt_sensors: 'on' = tilted. While the window is only tilted, covers close no further than the ventilation position.
data_description.group: Direction of the sun. Without a group the window has no sun protection.

data.manual_at_sun_position: Moving onto the sun protection position counts

data_description.radiation_threshold: Every radiation sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.pv_threshold: Every PV sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.lux_threshold: Every brightness sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.temperature_threshold: Sun protection only from this outdoor temperature on.
data_description.temperature_hold: The outdoor temperature must stay above the value this long. Below it the condition ends immediately.
data_description.room_entity: Optional: thermostat (climate) or temperature sensor of the room. Then the cover is only lowered when the room is too warm. Without a value the condition counts as met (except on a heating day).
data_description.room_margin: With a thermostat: too warm from its setpoint plus this margin.
data_description.room_threshold: With a temperature sensor (or a thermostat without a setpoint): too warm from this temperature.
data_description.cooling_entity: Optional: while this air conditioner cools, the room counts as too warm. Sun protection then takes load off the air conditioner.
data_description.sun_hold: Summer day, temperature, room and all sun sensors must be met this long. The condition ends immediately.
data_description.sun_position: Lowered once a day to this position. A cover already further closed is left alone.
data_description.position_tolerance: Auto up only opens covers standing at the sun protection position up to this much above it. Covers moved elsewhere by hand stay.
data_description.auto_up: Open again when the sun leaves the sector (not in the evening).
data_description.notify_open_window: Once a day, if an open window prevented the sun protection.
data_description.manual_max_position: A cover lowered by hand to at most this position while the sun shines counts as sun protection for today (no automatic movement).
data_description.manual_detection_window: The manual movement must not be longer ago than this.
data_description.manual_follow_up: For this detection the sun condition (without temperature) still counts this long after it ended.
data_description.manual_at_sun_position: A cover moved by anyone onto the sun protection position (up to the tolerance) while the sun shines is treated like automatic sun protection and opens again with auto up.

data.override_ignore_evening: Evening and vacation runs despite override

data_description.override_duration: After a manual movement the automatic pauses this long for the window. Every further movement starts it again. 0 = until sunrise.
data_description.override_ignore_evening: e.g. bedrooms that should always close in the evening.
data_description.override_sunrise_reset: The override also ends at the next sunrise, even if the duration is still running.

data_description.open_block_entity: No automatic opening (auto up, ventilation, vacation morning, morning opening) unless this entity has one of the free states (e.g. a TV).
data_description.close_trigger_entities: When one of these entities becomes active, the cover closes once per active cycle, only with a closed window (otherwise as soon as it is closed). The cycle ends when all are inactive.
data_description.window_exception_entity: While this entity is available, an open window does not prevent closing movements and no message is sent (e.g. an air conditioner with its hose through the balcony door). Not used for the vacation evening.
data_description.open_block_free_states: States of the opening block in which opening is still allowed (e.g. off, standby).
data_description.close_trigger_active_states: States in which a close trigger counts as active (e.g. on, playing for a TV).
data_description.close_trigger_on_delay: A trigger must be active this long before the cover closes (switching on briefly does not count).
data_description.close_trigger_off_delay: All triggers must be inactive this long before the cycle ends and switching on closes again.
data_description.close_trigger_min_position: Only closes when the cover is open further than this position.
data_description.close_trigger_max_lock: After this time at the latest a new cycle starts, even if the triggers were active all the time.

data_description.evening_close: Close at the start of the evening mode, once per evening and only with a closed window.
data_description.evening_position: Target of the evening run and of closing after the window was closed. 0 % = closed; e.g. 20 % leaves a gap on warm nights.
data_description.follow_up_close: If the window is closed in the evening, the cover closes (also during an override).
data_description.evening_custom: Use the following values instead of the global ones.
data_description.evening_earliest: The evening mode never starts before this time.
data_description.evening_elevation: The evening mode starts when the sun drops below this elevation (e.g. -4 °).
data_description.evening_latest: Time fallback: the evening mode starts at this time at the latest.

data_description.ventilation: Opening the window moves a closed cover to the ventilation position (in the evening after the short delay, during the day after the long one).
data_description.closed_position: Used for ventilation and the vacation morning.
data_description.ventilation_delay_day: The window must still be open afterwards.
data_description.vacation: Take part in the random opening and closing during vacation.
data_description.ventilation_delay_evening: In the evening mode the cover moves to the ventilation position after this short time.

data_description.weather_protection: Off = wind, rain and frost never move or limit this cover, whatever the positions below say. Turn it on for every window that should take part. With the automatic off (globally or for this window) there is no weather protection either.
data_description.wind_position: Empty = not affected. E.g. 100 % retracts external venetian blinds. Only with the weather protection of the window on.
data_description.window_wind_threshold: Empty = wind protection from the threshold of the basic settings. Otherwise this window is protected already or only from this value (unit of the wind sensor).
data_description.rain_position: Empty = not affected. E.g. 0 % for a roof window shutter.
data_description.frost_position: Empty = off. With frost, closing stops at this position so the cover cannot freeze on, e.g. 5 %.
data_description.protection_keep_closed: A cover already further closed than its position with wind or rain is not opened to it (e.g. closed at 0 % with a wind position of 20 %). Not for a position of 100 %: retracting external venetian blinds always runs.
data_description.lockout_protection: While the contact reports open, nothing closes below the ventilation position, also not with the window exception or the weather protection.

morning.title: Morning opening
morning.description: Never with an active override, an opening block or a cover moved by hand since the evening. During vacation the simulation opens instead.

data.morning_sun_position: Directly to sun protection if needed

data_description.morning_latest: If nothing triggered until then, the cover opens at this time.
data_description.morning_sun_position: If the sun condition applies, open only to the sun protection position.
data_description.morning_enabled: Open the cover automatically in the morning.
data_description.morning_mode: What starts the morning opening; its settings follow in the next step.
data_description.morning_earliest: The cover never opens before this time, even if the trigger comes earlier.

data_description.morning_time_workday: Time on workdays (workday sensor or weekend days).
data_description.morning_time_weekend: Time on weekends and public holidays (holidays only with a workday sensor).

data_description.morning_sun_elevation: Only for sun elevation: opens when the rising sun passes this elevation.
data_description.morning_sun_event: Sunrise or the sun reaching an elevation.
data_description.morning_sun_offset: Minutes before (negative) or after the event.

data_description.morning_lux_threshold: Every brightness sensor of the group must reach this value.
data_description.morning_lux_hold: It must be bright enough this long before the cover opens.

data_description.morning_trigger_entity: A timestamp (e.g. the next alarm of a phone) opens at that time plus offset. Any other entity opens when it turns on (motion, switch).

reconfigure.title: Change window
reconfigure.description: What do you want to change? Each category is saved on its own.

menu_options.sun: Sun protection: thresholds, hold times, position, auto up
menu_options.behavior: Behaviour: override, additional conditions, evening, ventilation, vacation

error.latest_before_earliest: The latest time is before the earliest one. Move the latest time later or the earliest earlier.
error.night_end_after_evening: The end of the night must be before the earliest evening start, e.g. 03:30 with an evening from 17:00.
error.min_above_max: The minimum is above the maximum. Swap or adjust the values.
error.azimuth_equal: Azimuth from and to must differ.
error.no_lux_sensor: The group of this window has no brightness sensor. Add a brightness sensor to the group or choose another mode.
error.need_temperature_source: Choose an outdoor temperature sensor or a weather entity; without a temperature there is no summer day.
error.not_numeric: This entity does not report a number. Choose a sensor with a measured value (e.g. °C, lx, W, W/m²).
error.invalid_notify_service: Only notification services (notify.…) are allowed. Choose a service from the list.
error.cover_in_use: This cover is already controlled by another window. Choose another cover or change the other window.
error.contact_in_use: This contact already belongs to another window. A contact belongs to one window only, otherwise one opening would count twice.
error.contact_or_cover_required: Choose a window contact or a cover; without either the window does nothing.
error.unknown_room: This room does not exist any more. Choose another one.

user.title: New meter
user.description: Name and type. The type sets suitable defaults in the next step.

details.title: {name}
details.description: Camera, display and schedule of the meter.

camera_section.name: Camera and light
camera_section.description: Camera of the meter and the light that is switched on for the picture.

data_description.camera: Camera entity pointed at the display (e.g. an ESP32-CAM with ESPHome).
data_description.light: Optional. Switched on for the picture and off again afterwards (e.g. the flash LED).
data_description.light_brightness: Brightness of the light for the picture. Try it with a test picture: reflections make the display unreadable.
data_description.light_brightness_2: Optional (0 = off): each attempt also takes a second picture with this brightness, and the AI gets both. Helps when at one brightness a light spot outshines digits and at the other digits are too dark. An attempt takes longer.
data_description.warmup: Wait after switching the light on, so the camera adjusts its exposure.
data_description.discard_frames: Pictures thrown away before the real one. Cameras with a buffer (ESP32-CAM) otherwise deliver an old picture without light.

external_light_section.name: External light
external_light_section.description: Optional extra light (light or switch entity) besides the light of the camera, e.g. LED modules. When it cannot be reached, the meter is read without it and a warning is logged.

data_description.external_light: Optional. Light or switch entity that lights the display in addition. Leave empty when there is none.
data_description.external_light_mode: Only while taking pictures: switched on before the pictures and off afterwards. Always on: only switched on when it is off, and left on.
data_description.external_light_brightness: Only for a light entity that can be dimmed; a switch is just switched on and off.
data_description.external_light_lead_time: Wait after switching the external light on, before the light of the camera is switched on and the pictures are taken.
data_description.external_light_turn_off: Only in the mode "Only while taking pictures": switches the light off after the pictures, also when taking or reading them fails.

image_section.name: Picture crop
image_section.description: Only this part of the picture is sent to the AI. Crop wide-angle cameras to the display; in the dashboard the crop can be drawn with the mouse.

data_description.crop_left: Left edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_top: Top edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_right: Right edge of the crop in percent of the width of the turned picture.
data_description.crop_bottom: Bottom edge of the crop in percent of the height of the turned picture.
data_description.rotate: Turns the picture clockwise by this angle (negative: counterclockwise), e.g. 90 for a camera mounted sideways or a few degrees for a display that sits askew. Turned before cropping, the crop refers to the turned picture.
data_description.exposure: Brightness of the picture for the AI: 100 % leaves it unchanged, below is darker (against reflections and overexposure), above is brighter.
data_description.enhance: Turns the picture grey, evens out the lighting and stretches the contrast before the AI reads it. Helps when the light leaves a bright spot on the display glass and dark corners, or with pale LCD segments. Not shown in the live picture; take a test picture to see it.

display_section.name: Display
display_section.description: What the display shows. The hints are passed on to the AI.

data_description.unit: Unit shown on the display (e.g. MWh, kWh or m³).
data_description.decimals: Number of decimals shown on the display.
data_description.hints: Optional. What is special about this display, e.g. lines that are not part of a digit, or which digits to ignore.
data_description.prompt: Replace the whole generated instructions (leave empty for the standard). Unit, decimals and hints are then no longer inserted. The AI should still answer only with the number or “unreadable”.

schedule_section.name: Schedule
schedule_section.description: How often the meter is read automatically.

data.condition_heating_day: Days without heating like condition off
data.interval_off: Interval while the condition is off

data_description.condition_entity: Optional. While this entity is 'off', the second interval applies (e.g. a heating day sensor).
data_description.condition_heating_day: The second interval also applies on days without heating (heating day of the heating module, only within the heating period). With the heating off or an unknown heating day the normal interval applies.
data_description.interval_off: Only together with a condition or the days without heating.
data_description.heating_interval: Heat meters and meters of the heating day: time between two readings while a room heats and up to 30 minutes after. Every change of the value closes a heating phase.
data_description.idle_interval: Heat meters and meters of the heating day: time between two readings while no room heats (then the meter is only checked).

checks_section.name: Checks
checks_section.description: Majority vote and plausibility check of a reading.

data_description.max_rate: In the meter unit. A larger increase since the last valid reading is rejected (e.g. 0.05 MWh = 50 kW).
data_description.max_correction: In the meter unit. A smaller value than before is only taken when it is at most this much lower and confirmed by further pictures.
data_description.max_attempts: Most pictures until a value has been read twice.
data_description.confirmations: Further pictures that must all show a smaller value before it is taken as a correction.
data_description.history_hint: The AI gets the last 3 valid readings as a hint, to decide an unclear digit plausibly. It should still read only what the picture shows; the checks here stay in place. Can tempt the AI to name an expected value, so use it mainly for displays that are hard to read.
data_description.meter_ai_task_entity: Optional. Instead of the AI task of the integration.

notify_section.name: Notifications
notify_section.description: From the how-many-th time in a row a notification appears in Home Assistant (0 = never, 1 = at once). A valid reading starts the count again. Only while notifications are switched on in the settings of the integration.

data_description.notify_smaller: Value below the last valid one and not confirmed as a correction (rejected).
data_description.notify_too_large: Value rose more than the largest increase per hour allows (rejected).
data_description.notify_corrected: Smaller value confirmed by more pictures and taken.
data_description.notify_failed: The AI reads nothing clear, or the camera or AI is not reachable. Unreadable readings do not interrupt the count of the other cases.

vacation_section.name: Vacation
vacation_section.description: Warns when something runs on vacation: a message, a logbook entry and the event house_assistant_vacation_alert, once per vacation and case. Counted from the last valid reading before the vacation. Not for the heat meter.

data_description.vacation_alert: Default: on for a water meter, else off.
data_description.vacation_amount: Used since the vacation started, in litres (water, gas) or kWh (electricity), from which it warns. 0 = off. Default water: 20 L.
data_description.vacation_rate: Mean since the vacation started in L/h or kW (after an hour at the earliest) from which it warns. For gas and electricity enter the base load. 0 = off. Default water: 5 L/h.

data.interval_off: Interval while the condition is off

data_description.condition_entity: Optional. While this entity is 'off', the second interval applies (e.g. a heating day sensor).
data_description.interval_off: Only used together with a condition.
data_description.heating_interval: Heat meters and meters of the heating day: time between two readings while a room heats and up to 30 minutes after. Every change of the value closes a heating phase.
data_description.idle_interval: Heat meters and meters of the heating day: time between two readings while no room heats (then the meter is only checked).

checks_section.name: Checks
checks_section.description: Majority vote and plausibility check of a reading.

data_description.max_rate: In the meter unit. A larger increase since the last valid reading is rejected (e.g. 0.05 MWh = 50 kW).
data_description.max_correction: In the meter unit. A smaller value than before is only taken when it is at most this much lower and confirmed by further pictures.
data_description.max_attempts: Most pictures until a value has been read twice.
data_description.confirmations: Further pictures that must all show a smaller value before it is taken as a correction.
data_description.history_hint: The AI gets the last 3 valid readings as a hint, to decide an unclear digit plausibly. It should still read only what the picture shows; the checks here stay in place. Can tempt the AI to name an expected value, so use it mainly for displays that are hard to read.
data_description.meter_ai_task_entity: Optional. Instead of the AI task of the integration.

notify_section.name: Notifications
notify_section.description: From the how-many-th time in a row a notification appears in Home Assistant (0 = never, 1 = at once). A valid reading starts the count again. Only while notifications are switched on in the settings of the integration.

data_description.notify_smaller: Value below the last valid one and not confirmed as a correction (rejected).
data_description.notify_too_large: Value rose more than the largest increase per hour allows (rejected).
data_description.notify_corrected: Smaller value confirmed by more pictures and taken.
data_description.notify_failed: The AI reads nothing clear, or the camera or AI is not reachable. Unreadable readings do not interrupt the count of the other cases.

vacation_section.name: Vacation
vacation_section.description: Warns when something runs on vacation: a message, a logbook entry and the event house_assistant_vacation_alert, once per vacation and case. Counted from the last valid reading before the vacation. Not for the heat meter.

data_description.vacation_alert: Default: on for a water meter, else off.
data_description.vacation_amount: Used since the vacation started, in litres (water, gas) or kWh (electricity), from which it warns. 0 = off. Default water: 20 L.
data_description.vacation_rate: Mean since the vacation started in L/h or kW (after an hour at the earliest) from which it warns. For gas and electricity enter the base load. 0 = off. Default water: 5 L/h.

options.movement: Only when the cover really moves
options.command: With every command by hand, also without movement

no_meter.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a meter of House Assistant.

negative.message: The meter reading must not be negative.

unknown_cover.message: {entity_id} does not belong to a window of House Assistant.

unknown_area.message: {entity_id} is not a thermostat of House Assistant.

ai_disabled.message: The AI is disabled or not configured.

departure_after_return.message: The departure must be before the return.

return_in_past.message: The return is in the past.

read_meter.name: Read meter
read_meter.description: Reads the meters of the given entities now (with majority vote and plausibility check).

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Any entity of the meter (e.g. its meter reading).

set_meter_reading.name: Set meter reading
set_meter_reading.description: Sets the meter reading by hand, e.g. after a wrong reading. The next readings are checked against this value.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Any entity of the meter (e.g. its meter reading).

value.name: Value
value.description: New meter reading in the unit of the meter.

move_cover.name: Move
move_cover.description: Moves windows of House Assistant without starting an override. Frost and the lockout protection still apply.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

action.name: Action
action.description: Evening and sun protection use the positions of the window and are remembered like the automatic's own runs.

start_cover_override.name: Start override
start_cover_override.description: Pauses the automatic of windows like a manual movement.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Empty = the duration of the window. 0 = until sunrise.

end_cover_override.name: End override
end_cover_override.description: Ends a running override; the automatic decides at its next occasion.

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

resume_cover.name: Resume automatic
resume_cover.description: Ends an override and lets the automatic decide right away (sun protection, evening run).

entity_id.name: Covers
entity_id.description: Covers of configured windows. Empty = all windows.

export_parameters.name: Export parameters
export_parameters.description: Returns learned values and parameters as JSON (e.g. to save or move them).

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: Thermostats of the rooms. Empty = all.

import_parameters.name: Import parameters
import_parameters.description: Sets learned values and parameters from JSON (format of the export). Values are checked against the limits.

data.name: Data
data.description: JSON object as produced by the export.

entity_id.name: Rooms
entity_id.description: Only import these rooms. Empty = all in the data.

reset_learned.name: Reset learned values
reset_learned.description: Resets the learned values of the selected rooms to the start values.

include_parameters.name: Also reset parameters
include_parameters.description: Also resets the parameters adjusted by the AI.

run_ai_check.name: Run AI check
run_ai_check.description: Runs the periodic AI check now (budget applies).

run_ai_ventilation_check.name: Run AI ventilation check
run_ai_ventilation_check.description: Runs the AI check of the ventilation thresholds now (budget applies).

decide_heating_day.name: Decide heating day
decide_heating_day.description: Runs the heating day decision now.

use_ai.name: Ask the AI
use_ai.description: If off, only the local rule decides.

set_vacation.name: Plan vacation
set_vacation.description: Sets departure and return of the vacation of the house. At the departure the vacation switches on, at the return off. Only a return: vacation from now on.

departure.name: Departure
departure.description: Vacation from then on. Empty: as before.

return.name: Return
return.description: The vacation ends then (the heating preheats in time). A return in the past is ignored.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: First ends the vacation and removes departure and return.

missing_group.title: Group of a window is missing
missing_group.description: The window {window} refers to a deleted group and has no sun protection. Choose a group in the settings of the window.

forecast_unsupported.title: Weather entity provides no forecast
forecast_unsupported.description: {weather} supports none of the forecast kinds daily, twice daily or hourly. The summer day then only starts by the outdoor temperature. Choose another weather entity in the settings of House Assistant.

sensor_unavailable.title: Temperature sensor of {area} unavailable
sensor_unavailable.description:
The temperature sensor {entity_id} of the room {area} has not delivered a valid value for at least 15 minutes. Without the room temperature the heating circuit stays off, and frost protection cannot work either.

Check the sensor (battery, radio connection, its integration) or choose another temperature sensor in the settings of the room. This message disappears by itself as soon as the sensor delivers values again.

actuator_unavailable.title: Switch of {area} unavailable
actuator_unavailable.description:
The switch {entity_id} of the room {area} has been unavailable for at least 15 minutes, so the heating circuit cannot be switched and stays in its last state.

Check the device (power supply, radio connection, its integration) or choose another switch in the settings of the room. This message disappears by itself as soon as the switch is available again.

actuator_not_responding.title: Switch of {area} does not respond
actuator_not_responding.description:
The switch {entity_id} of the room {area} did not change its state after several switching commands. The integration keeps trying with growing pauses (up to 15 minutes).

Check whether the device reacts when you switch it by hand in Home Assistant, and whether another automation switches it back. This message disappears as soon as the switch follows the commands again.

outdoor_unavailable.title: Outdoor temperature sensor unavailable
outdoor_unavailable.description:
The outdoor temperature sensor {entity_id} has not delivered a valid value for at least 15 minutes. The control keeps running, but the prediction is less accurate and the thermal model learns nothing meanwhile.

Check the sensor or choose another one in the heating settings (General). This message disappears by itself as soon as the sensor delivers values again.
